top_signals.title: Crypto thief who splurged on gold grills sentenced in London
top_signals.summary: A 25-year-old man who helped steal nearly $260,000 in cryptocurrency through a SIM-swapping fraud scheme was sentenced to two and a half years in prison at a London court.

top_signals.title: Fixed Income Leaders Dialogue
top_signals.summary: The fixed income landscape is evolving as public and private credit converge, AI-related financing accelerates and investors navigate a more complex credit cycle. TCW CIO of Fixed Income Bryan Whalen and Blackstone Credit & Insurance’s Philip Sherrill were in conversation with Bloomberg’s Scarlet Fu at the Bloomberg Future of Fixed Income 2026 conference in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)
